bio.text: Mary Peltola, a Democrat, is a candidate for the U.S. Senate in Alaska in 2026, challenging Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan.
She was Alaska's at-large U.S. Representative from 2022 to 2024, the first woman and first Alaska Native elected to represent the state in the House, and narrowly lost re-election in 2024.
She served in the Alaska House of Representatives from 1999 to 2009, directed the Kuskokwim River Inter-Tribal Fish Commission from 2017 to 2022, and was a tribal judge in Bethel from 2020 to 2021.
According to her campaign, she grew up in Kwethluk and Bethel and she raised seven children in Alaska.
